vocabulary.meaning_en: to punish someone for breaking rules; the act of doing this
vocabulary.example: The manager had to discipline a member of staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: official steps a company takes when an employee breaks rules
vocabulary.example: Stealing can lead to disciplinary action.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a spoken warning that you must improve, before more serious action
vocabulary.note_en: Written warning = a more serious, written one.
vocabulary.example: He got a verbal warning for being late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who has just joined a company
vocabulary.example: The new recruit starts on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a formal complaint
vocabulary.example: If it happens again, I will complain officially.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a written note of what happened
vocabulary.example: Keep a record of your conversation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to write down important points
vocabulary.example: Keep notes during the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: talk only about what really happened, not opinions
vocabulary.example: In a complaint, stick to the facts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to criticise someone's character or looks instead of their work
vocabulary.example: Don't get personal – talk about the work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something to solve a problem
vocabulary.example: You have to take some action.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when someone allows you to do something
vocabulary.example: You have my permission to discipline her.

vocabulary.meaning_en: important and possibly dangerous or bad
vocabulary.example: You've made some serious mistakes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to ask someone for advice or information before you act
vocabulary.example: Consult me before you contact any client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to call, email or write to someone
vocabulary.note_en: As a verb, say contact someone, not contact with someone.
vocabulary.example: Please contact me if you have questions.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send a problem to someone else to deal with
vocabulary.example: I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to cause a particular result
vocabulary.example: Being late every day could result in a warning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone unhappy or worried
vocabulary.example: She has upset our new client.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stay relaxed and not get angry
vocabulary.example: Keep calm and be professional.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not needed
vocabulary.example: That comment was unnecessary.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who steals
vocabulary.example: So Rachel is the pen thief!

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take something that is not yours without permission
vocabulary.example: Someone has been stealing the company's pens.

vocabulary.meaning_en: paper, pens and other things for writing in an office
vocabulary.example: The stationery cupboard is empty.

fine_lines.title: verbal warning vs written warning
fine_lines.explanation_ar: verbal warning إنذار شفهي وهو الخطوة الأولى. written warning إنذار مكتوب يُحفظ في ملف الموظف وهو أشد. كلمة verbal تعني (بالكلام) هنا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: A verbal warning is spoken and is usually the first step. A written warning is on paper, goes in your file and is more serious.

examples.sentence: She got a verbal warning for being rude.
After a second mistake, he received a written warning.

fine_lines.title: stationery vs stationary
fine_lines.explanation_ar: stationery (بحرف e) تعني الأدوات المكتبية: أقلام وأوراق. stationary (بحرف a) صفة تعني ثابتًا لا يتحرك. النطق واحد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Stationery (with e) means pens, paper and office supplies. Stationary (with a) means not moving. They sound the same.

examples.sentence: The car was stationary at the lights.

expressions.meaning_en: Starting a verbal warning clearly and calmly.
expressions.example: I need to tell you that you've made some serious mistakes.

expressions.phrase: You need to consult me before you contact any of our clients.
expressions.meaning_ar: عليك استشارتي قبل أن تتواصل مع أيٍّ من عملائنا.
expressions.meaning_en: Setting a clear rule for an employee.
expressions.example: From now on, you need to consult me before you contact any of our clients.

expressions.phrase: These mistakes cannot happen again, otherwise I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا يجوز أن تتكرر هذه الأخطاء، وإلا فسأضطر إلى رفع الأمر إلى مسؤول أعلى.
expressions.meaning_en: Giving a warning about what will happen next.
expressions.example: These mistakes cannot happen again, otherwise I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.

expressions.phrase: It could result in disciplinary action.
expressions.meaning_ar: قد يؤدي ذلك إلى إجراء تأديبي.
expressions.example: Being late again could result in disciplinary action.
Rachel, can we talk, please? It's important.

expressions.meaning_en: Giving a task to someone else to handle.
expressions.example: I've got a meeting now, so I'll leave it with you.

expressions.phrase: I need to see you in my office, please.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحتاج إلى رؤيتك في مكتبي من فضلك.
expressions.meaning_en: A formal request from a manager.
expressions.example: Could you come to my office, please? I need to see you.

grammar.title: otherwise = if not
grammar.explanation_ar: otherwise تعني (وإلا / إن لم يحدث ذلك) وتربط بين تحذير ونتيجته: These mistakes cannot happen again, otherwise I will refer the matter.
grammar.explanation_en: 'otherwise' means 'if not'. It links a warning and its result: These mistakes cannot happen again, otherwise I will refer the matter.
examples: These mistakes cannot happen again, otherwise I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.
Save your work, otherwise you may lose it.
We must leave now, otherwise we'll miss the train.

grammar.title: need to / have to for obligation
grammar.explanation_ar: need to + الفعل: شيء ضروري (You need to consult me). have to + الفعل: التزام بسبب ظرف أو قاعدة (I will have to refer the matter).
grammar.explanation_en: need to + verb: something necessary. have to + verb: an obligation because of a rule or situation.
examples: You need to consult me before you contact any clients.
I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.
We have to fill in this form.

grammar.title: before + present simple for future
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد before (وكذلك when, after, until) نستخدم المضارع البسيط حتى لو كان المعنى مستقبلًا: before you contact any clients، وليس before you will contact.
grammar.explanation_en: After before/when/after/until use the present simple even for the future: before you contact any clients, not 'before you will contact'.
examples: Consult me before you contact any clients.
Check the order before you send it.

questions.question: What is a 'verbal warning'?
questions.explanation_en: A verbal warning is a spoken warning.

questions.question: Complete: 'These mistakes cannot happen again, ___ I will have to refer the matter to someone higher.'
Choose the correct sentence.
choices: You need to consult me before you contact any clients.
You need to consult me before you will contact any clients.
You need consult me before you contacting any clients.
You need to consult me before contact with any clients.

questions.question: The narrator tells Anna to 'stick to the facts'. What does that mean?
choices: talk only about what really happened
questions.explanation_ar: stick to the facts تعني الالتزام بما حدث فعلًا.
questions.explanation_en: It means talk only about real events.

questions.question: 'Don't get personal' means…
choices: don't criticise someone's character or looks
questions.explanation_ar: get personal تعني انتقاد الشخص نفسه بدل عمله.
questions.explanation_en: It means attacking the person, not the work.

questions.question: Which word means 'pens, paper and office supplies'?
questions.explanation_ar: stationery بحرف e هي الأدوات المكتبية.

questions.question: What does 'consult' mean?
choices: ask someone for advice before you act

questions.question: Paul says 'I'll leave it with you.' He means…
questions.explanation_ar: يعني أنه يترك المهمة لآنا لتتعامل معها.
questions.explanation_en: He means Anna should deal with it.

questions.question: A person who has just joined a company is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A new recruit has just joined.
